title: WebSocketSecurityConfigData

x-agp.mechanics: Defines the security value owned by the WebSocket binding.
x-agp.rationale: Carrier-specific configuration and mapping remain outside the neutral kernel.
x-agp.consequence: Divergence makes WebSocket behavior ambiguous or leaks carrier authority.

description: Declared WebSocket security profile, carrying no secret value.

mode.description: TLS 1.3 pre-shared-key profile; secrets arrive through PresharedKeyPort.

keying.description: Whether one secret covers the topology or one covers each identity.
